_llm_instructions: Fill in the 'project_title' and 'date_prepared' properties, and the 'value' property of each field, based on the provided project context. Reference parameters.md for global project variables.

f01_Requirements_Definition_and_Manageme.label: Requirements Definition and Management / What Worked Well
f01_Requirements_Definition_and_Manageme.guidance: Practices or incidents that were effective in defining and managing requirements. Name the practice, not the meeting where it was discussed.

f02_Requirements_Definition_and_Manageme.label: Requirements Definition and Management / What Can Be Improved

f04_Scope_Definition_and_Management_What.label: Scope Definition and Management / What Can Be Improved

f05_Schedule_Development_and_Control_Wha.label: Schedule Development and Control / What Worked Well

f07_Cost_Estimating_and_Control_What_Wor.label: Cost Estimating and Control / What Worked Well

f08_Cost_Estimating_and_Control_What_Can.label: Cost Estimating and Control / What Can Be Improved

f30_Other_What_Can_Be_Improved.guidance: Other practices or incidents that can be improved, such as change control, configuration management, or integration management.

f31_Risk_or_Issue.label: Risk or Issue
f31_Risk_or_Issue.guidance: Describe the risk or issue that occurred and should be considered to improve organizational learning.

f32_Response.label: Response
f32_Response.guidance: Describe the response that was taken and its effectiveness. Say plainly whether the response worked.

f33_Comments.label: Comments
f33_Comments.guidance: Provide any additional information needed to improve future project performance.

f34_Defect.label: Defect
f34_Defect.guidance: Describe the quality defect that should be considered to improve organizational effectiveness.

f35_Resolution.guidance: Describe how the defect was resolved and whether the resolution held.

f36_Comments.label: Comments
f36_Comments.guidance: Indicate what should be done to improve future project performance.

f37_Vendor.label: Vendor
f37_Vendor.guidance: List the vendor or vendors concerned.

f38_Issue.label: Issue
f38_Issue.guidance: Describe any issues, claims, or disputes that occurred with this vendor.

f39_Resolution.label: Resolution
f39_Resolution.guidance: Describe the outcome or resolution that was reached.

f40_Comments.label: Comments
f40_Comments.guidance: Indicate what should be done to improve future vendor management performance.
